en.name: Navia
en.ability: Each night, choose a living player: if they're executed tomorrow day, learn their nominator's character tonight.

revisions.v1: Each night, choose a living player: if they're executed tomorrow day, learn their nominator's character tonight.

en.flavor: When we were kids we played a board game where she was the adventurer and I was the host. I consider myself good at dealing with emergencies, but I am still often caught off guard by her choices and answers. But that's what makes it interesting. By Clorinde
en.firstNightReminder: Wake the Navia up, They point at any alive player and a "chosen" token is placed next to their character token. Then, put the Navia to sleep.
en.otherNightReminder: Wake the Navia up, They point at any alive player and a "chosen" token is placed next to their character token. If player she choose yesterday was executed that day, show nominator's character's token.Then, put the Navia to sleep.
